definition: my two closest friendships, one lost to the org chart and one that bills as exposure

settled:
I had already lost one of my two closest friends a few years before the firing, when my brother fired him while I was on holiday in Europe. He blamed me for it, for something I had no hand in.

Same shape, earlier. Where the friendships live inside an org chart, the org chart's decisions take the people.

The other one is still on reasonably good terms, and talking to him is still exposure, with the alarm going off every time. The last two conversations averaged two days in bed afterwards.

Those conversations are the whole of the wearing-off path, because nothing in me rehearses it in between. Every repetition costs two days.

So a tie on reasonably good terms still bills as an exposure rather than as an hour that pays down what I owe.

title: The Friends The Company Cost Me
